text: 央行答一财：上半年企业直接融资同比多增较多 非金融企业债券净融资、非金融企业股票融资两者合计占社会融资规模增量的11.3%，比上年同期高5.6个百分点。
text_en: PBOC responds to Yicai: Corporate direct financing saw a significant year-on-year increase in H1; combined net corporate bond financing and non-financial corporate equity financing accounted for 11.3% of aggregate social financing increment, up 5.6 percentage points from the same period last year.
